issues.explanation: Verification controllers in App\Http\Controllers\Auth extend bare Controller which resolves to non-existent App\Http\Controllers\Auth\Controller, causing a fatal error on the verify/notice/resend flow.
Resend action type-hints Request without importing Illuminate\Http\Request, so the class resolves to App\Http\Controllers\Auth\Request and fatals when called.
Password defaults are set to a bare Password rule with no letters/mixedCase/numbers constraints, so weak passwords pass despite the task requiring min 8 plus letters, mixed case and numbers.
Password reset callback saves the hash and rotates remember_token but never fires the PasswordReset event required by the task.
Logout route is placed inside the auth+verified group, so unverified users cannot log out; it must require only auth.
Reset view hides the e-mail in a hidden input and references a non-existent ui.password_confirmation key, instead of showing one visible e-mail input.
No change to .env.example ships APP_NAME, APP_LOCALE and APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE as required.
E-mail validation uses plain email in login, register, forgot and reset flows instead of the strict variant required by the task.
Livewire components validate with inline $this->validate([...]) and no #[Validate] attributes, violating the mandated #[Validate] plus $this->validate() pattern.
Livewire full-page views use @extends('layouts.app') inside the component view instead of returning the view with a layout, the wrong Livewire full-page pattern.
Register hits the rate limiter on every attempt then clears it after success, so successful registrations never count and an attacker can create unlimited accounts.
The diff ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests, missing happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests required for every feature and Livewire action.
AppServiceProvider defines RateLimiter::for('login'/'register') limiters that nothing uses since the components build manual keys, leaving dead rate-limit code.
Login/Register controllers carry unused imports and a split return-type line that suggest Pint was not run and obscure review.
All new files serve the auth task with no unrelated features; only nit-level dead limiter code is extra.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:248 inline $this->validate without #[Validate]; resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:643 @extends inside Livewire view instead of ->layout(); unused imports e.g. Guard/Password/Hash; existing welcome/bulma-test views untouched for route() rule

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:272 split return type "/\" newline; unused imports in 6 controllers/components; resources/views/auth/reset-password.blade.php uses missing __('ui.password_confirmation') key

requirements.evidence: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:394 Password::defaults bare; app/Http/Controllers/ResetPasswordController.php:198 no PasswordReset event; routes/web.php:757 logout under verified; .env.example untouched; app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:249 plain email not strict; verify controllers fatal extends/import

scope.evidence: routes/web.php:751-770, all new auth controllers/views/lang keys serve the task; no unrelated refactors except dead RateLimiter::for block

security.evidence: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:394 weak password rule accepts weak secrets; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:331 hit-then-clear limiter bypass; app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:254 correct lowercase-email+IP key and auth.throttle/auth.failed usage; views use {{ }} escaping

simplicity.evidence: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:397-406 duplicated unused limiters; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:323 double-prefixed 'register:'.$key; extra password_confirmation required rule

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-770 contains no tests/ directory additions and no Pest coverage for login/register/logout/password/verification

review.summary: The change implements the login, register, logout, home and password scaffolding with correct route names, translations and session handling, but verification controllers fatal on missing Controller/Request imports, the password default is too weak, PasswordReset is never fired, logout wrongly requires verified, strict e-mail and .env.example pins are missing, and no tests ship. Needs substantial rework before merge.
